title: Repository bootstrap and canonical agent protocol
purpose: Establish the vendor-neutral repository protocol required before G0 packages can become Ready.

include: Canonical agent guide and thin Codex/Claude adapters
Machine-readable protocol schemas and directory structure
Repository consistency and synthetic-only secret-scan evidence
Approved bootstrap runtime, lockfile, Node-only protocol validator, and read-only CI workflow
exclude: Product/domain implementation, schema migrations, provider integrations, and credentials

amended_by.change: package.json was removed from writable_paths and outputs.files and transferred to WP-0A-A0-002. This package did author package.json; the removal is forced by scripts/validate-work-package-ownership.mjs, which exits 70 while two packages hold the same path. No status, role, gate, or delivered output of this package changed.

scripts/scan-repository-secrets.mjs and test-kits/secret-scan.test.mjs were removed from writable_paths and outputs.files and transferred to WP-0A-A0-003. No status, role, gate or delivered output of this package changed.

.github/workflows/ci.yml was removed from writable_paths and outputs.files and transferred to WP-0A-A0-004, so the workflow can invoke the test-integrity guard as its own step. No status, role, gate or delivered output of this package changed.
package.json gained one script, record:verification. Ownership stays with this package; npm run check is unchanged.

ownership.amended_by_shape_note: An array, because this package now carries three amendments and JSON cannot hold a duplicate key. The first element is the original WP-0A-A0-002 record, unchanged. Independent review found the RFC-2026-005 and RFC-2026-007 amendments were both unrecorded while RFC-2026-007 asserted as present fact that the record existed.

amends_without_owning.rationale: Two decision dispositions, both owned by no package because architecture/decisions and the decision register are unowned. OPEN-018 asks for language, runtime and package manager together. This package owns the two RFCs that answered runtime and package manager, so the language half belongs with them; RFC-2026-011 and the decision register are owned by no package. The other two paths are the consequence, not new work: a new decision record must be declared in DIGESTED_FLOOR (scripts/verify-test-coverage-floor.mjs, WP-0A-A0-002) and carry a digest (test-kits/integrity-manifest.json, the same package), or the guard that keeps a decision record from being edited unnoticed exits 87 on it. Four literal paths, no tree. RFC-2026-012 disposes OPEN-015 (the client/server database boundary), prepared by A1 as the register requires; it is carried on this branch rather than opened as a second package because its declaration cost is the identical three files and no package owns a decision record.

ownership.forbidden_paths_note: The globs **/*secret* and **/*credential* were removed: they forbade this package's own declared outputs (the secret scanner and its test), a contradiction the ownership validator could not see until it began comparing outputs against forbidden_paths. Replaced with the extensions that carry actual key material. A filename mentioning "secret" is not a secret; a private key file is.

acceptance_criteria: Canonical guide is the sole full agent-policy source and adapters only point to it.
Role profiles use stable role IDs and display names without pretending that an unassigned role is an agent run.
Package, status, handoff, and capability schemas declare protocol version 1.0.0.
The named Author, Reviewer, Tester, and Integration Owner IDs are non-empty and pairwise distinct before a package is Ready or later.
No production secret or customer data is introduced.
The package has real role assignments and may advance only through independent review, test, and integration evidence.
Bootstrap ownership is limited to the listed A0 outputs; later work packages receive explicit non-overlapping writable paths.
required_tests: JSON syntax validation for all .agents schemas and JSON manifests
Node-only role-separation validator for every Ready-or-later JSON manifest
Node-only capability-profile validator that requires declarations for every Ready-or-later role run
Node-only ownership validator that requires exact declared outputs, writable-path coverage, and no cross-package output collision
Node-only synthetic secret-pattern scan of repository candidate files
Pinned Node/npm version and npm clean-install verification
Synthetic-only secret-pattern scan of newly added tracked files
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert the bootstrap-only commit; no persisted data or external state is created.
open_blockers: Cross-vendor protocol dry run is required for G0 evidence and cannot be represented by a placeholder.
Native repository branch protection remains unavailable: the recorded GitHub API response requires GitHub Pro or a public repository; RFC-2026-002 is procedural only.
Capability declarations and benchmark references must map real agent runs to required skill profiles before later packages become Ready.
